topArticle.title: Indonesia: Strong earthquake hits off coast of Flores island

topArticle.title: Vast German wildfire forces evacuation in Eifel forest
topArticle.description: Firefighters tackling the biggest forest fire in the history of North Rhine-Westphalia say residents are unlikely to be able to return on Friday amid high temperatures, humidity and wind. DW has the latest.

topArticle.title: US missionary released following kidnap in Niger, Christian group says
topArticle.description: Kevin Rideout, who was kidnapped outside his home in the capital last October, is now with US officials.

topArticle.title: DRC’s fast-growing Ebola outbreak spreads to sixth province
topArticle.description:
Man dies in Bas-Uele after travelling from Haut-Uele, as head of WHO says outbreak on track to be deadliest ever
The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to a sixth province, officials have said, a day after the head of the World Health Organization said the outbreak was on track to surpass the deadliest in history, which killed at least 11,000 people more than a decade ago.
The current outbreak has killed more than 2,100 people out of more than 4,500 cases, according to the latest government figures released on Tuesday. At the same point in the 2014-16 outbreak in west Africa, the previous most deadly outbreak, 755 cases had been recorded, according to WHO data.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、6番目の州に拡大
topArticle.summary: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱が6番目の州に拡大し、WHOは過去最悪の流行になる可能性を指摘。2,100人以上が死亡している。

topArticle.title: French ambassador to CAR investigated over claims he hosted dozens of women
topArticle.description:
Disciplinary proceedings under way after security concerns raised over reported visits to official residence
France has opened disciplinary proceedings against its ambassador to Central African Republic over allegations of misconduct, after claims he brought dozens of women into his official residence, raising potential security concerns.
The investigation comes as Paris seeks to rebuild relations with CAR after their sharp deterioration in recent years amid Russia’s expanding influence in the former French colony.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: フランスの駐中央アフリカ大使、数十人の女性を招いた疑惑で調査
topArticle.summary: フランスの駐中央アフリカ大使が、数十人の女性を公邸に招き治安上の懸念を引き起こしたとされる疑惑で懲戒手続きが開始された。

topArticle.title: A burial row over Zambia's late president has turned its election into a hot contest
topArticle.description: Hakainde Hichilema was a shoo-in for a second term but the controversy following Edgar Lungu's death has dented his chances.
topArticle.titleJa: ザンビア故大統領の埋葬を巡る騒動が選挙を激戦に変える
topArticle.summary: ザンビアでは、故エドガー・ルング大統領の埋葬を巡る論争が、当初優勢だった現職大統領の再選の可能性を揺るがし、選挙戦を白熱させている。

topArticle.title: At least 44 dead after overcrowded ferry capsizes on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe
topArticle.description:
Operation under way to rescue dozens missing after boat overturned by waves at world’s largest human-made lake
At least 44 people have died after an overcrowded ferry capsized on Lake Kariba in Zimbabwe, police said.
The boat had a capacity of 90 people, but was carrying 114 adult passengers, five crew members and an unknown number of children, Zimbabwe’s civil protection unit (CPU) said earlier on Wednesday, citing ticket sales.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: ジンバブエのカリバ湖で過密フェリーが転覆、少なくとも44人死亡
topArticle.summary: ジンバブエのカリバ湖で過密状態のフェリーが転覆し、少なくとも44人が死亡したと警察が発表。数十人が行方不明となっている。

topArticle.title: Canadian airline WestJet agrees to settle flight attendants’ sexual harassment class action
topArticle.description:
Female staff alleged company failed to maintain safe workplace, after allegations of sexual assault against pilot
The Canadian airline WestJet has agreed to pay C$4.5m (£2.4m) to settle a decade-long sexual harassment class action lawsuit levelled by its female flight attendants, who alleged the company failed to maintain a safe workplace.
The suit followed allegations by Mandalena Lewis, a former flight attendant, that a pilot had sexually assaulted her and a colleague, but that WestJet kept the pilot flying, thereby putting other employees at risk.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: カナダのウエストジェット航空、客室乗務員のセクハラ集団訴訟で和解合意
topArticle.summary: カナダのウエストジェット航空が、客室乗務員が提起したセクハラ集団訴訟について、450万カナダドルの支払いで和解に合意した。

topArticle.title: Why Venezuela’s earthquakes were so devastating: Geology, vulnerability, and years of structural neglect
topArticle.description: The dual earthquakes revealed how geology, corruption, and a longstanding humanitarian emergency amplified destruction across La Guaira, Caracas and seven other Venezuelan cities.
topArticle.titleJa: ベネズエラ地震が壊滅的だった理由：地質、脆弱性、長年の構造的怠慢
topArticle.summary: ベネズエラでの二度の地震が壊滅的だったのは、地質、腐敗、長年の人道危機が重なり、ラ・グアイラやカラカスなど各地で被害が拡大したためである。

topArticle.title: Former Mexican governor charged in case of 43 students who vanished in 2014
topArticle.description:
Ángel Aguirre indicted in case that rocked Mexico and became symbol of its brutal cartel violence
The former governor of Guerrero state in Mexico has been formally charged over his alleged involvement in the disappearance of 43 students in 2014, a case that has become a symbol of the country’s brutal cartel violence and government impunity.
Ángel Aguirre, who was arrested last week, is accused of forced disappearance and obstruction of justice for ordering the destruction of surveillance tapes that may have shed light on what happened to the students from the Ayotzinapa teacher training college on the night of 26 September 2014.
 Continue reading...
topArticle.titleJa: メキシコ元知事、2014年の学生43人失踪事件で起訴

topArticle.title: Judo World Tour: A day of firsts at the Lima Grand Prix

topArticle.title: Cristiano Ronaldo marries long-time partner Georgina Rodríguez
topArticle.description: The couple have tied the knot after the Portuguese captain played his last ever World Cup this summer.
topArticle.titleJa: クリスティアーノ・ロナウドが長年のパートナー、ジョルジーナ・ロドリゲスと結婚
topArticle.summary: ポルトガル代表のキャプテンであるクリスティアーノ・ロナウド選手が、この夏に最後のワールドカップを終えた後、長年のパートナーであるジョルジーナ・ロドリゲスさんと結婚した。

topArticle.title: In shattered Cali, residents search for loved ones and signs of hope
topArticle.description: Most deaths from the magnitude-7.4 quake were reported in Cali, Colombia’s third-most populous city, as crews search collapsed buildings for those still trapped.
topArticle.titleJa: 壊滅したカリで、住民が愛する人々と希望の兆しを探す
topArticle.summary: マグニチュード7.4の地震による死者の大半がコロンビア第3の都市カリで報告され、救助隊が倒壊した建物から生存者を捜索。

topArticle.title: Discord ordered to suspend livestreams in Brazil
topArticle.description: Discord told the BBC it was "thoughtfully reviewing" the order by Brazil's data protection agency and it was "committed to user safety"
topArticle.titleJa: ブラジルでDiscordにライブストリーム停止命令
topArticle.summary: ブラジルのデータ保護機関からライブストリーム停止命令が出され、Discordは慎重に検討中と表明した。

topArticle.title: 70 years on, Argentine court declares ‘Operation Massacre’ a crime against humanity
topArticle.description: The victims’ families testified in court for the first time: "We want justice served. Even though their killers are no longer here, I want the truth known.”
topArticle.titleJa: 70年を経て、アルゼンチン裁判所が「虐殺作戦」を人道に対する罪と宣言
topArticle.summary: アルゼンチンの裁判所が70年前の「虐殺作戦」を人道に対する罪と認定。被害者家族が初めて法廷で証言し、真相究明と正義を求めた。

topArticle.title: Weaponizing citizenship: Silencing dissent in Nicaragua
topArticle.description: In this edition, we examine an authoritarian narrative making the case for denationalization in Nicaragua.
topArticle.titleJa: 市民権を武器にする：ニカラグアでの異議申し立ての沈黙化
topArticle.summary: ニカラグアで、異議申し立てを抑圧するために市民権剥奪を主張する権威主義的な物語が分析されている。

topArticle.title: Australian army whistleblower released on parole after more than two years in jail
topArticle.description: David McBride was jailed after pleading guilty to leaking military secrets about Afghanistan.
topArticle.titleJa: オーストラリア陸軍の内部告発者、2年以上の服役を経て仮釈放
topArticle.summary: アフガニスタンに関する軍事機密を漏洩した罪で服役していたオーストラリア陸軍の内部告発者デイヴィッド・マクブライドが仮釈放された。

topArticle.title: WTO panel issues report regarding Turkish measures on EVs and other types of vehicles
topArticle.description: On 28 July, the WTO circulated the panel report in the case brought by China in "Türkiye — Measures Concerning Electric Vehicles and Other Types of Vehicles from China" (DS629).
topArticle.titleJa: WTOパネル、トルコのEVなど車両措置に関する報告書を発行
topArticle.summary: WTOは、中国が提起したトルコのEV等車両措置に関するパネル報告書を配布した。

topArticle.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
topArticle.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
topArticle.titleJa: リトアニア、途上国・後発開発途上国の貿易スキル向上に3万ユーロを拠出
topArticle.summary: リトアニアは、途上国の貿易スキル向上支援として、WTOグローバル信託基金に3万ユーロを拠出した。
